title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Numbers 29: the offerings of the seventh month, from the day of blowing of trumpets to the eighth day of the feast.

questions.text: What was the first day of the seventh month called for Israel?
questions.explanation: On the first day of the seventh month they were to have a holy convocation; it was a day of blowing of trumpets to them.

answers.text: A day of blowing of trumpets
A day of offering the firstborn

questions.text: What burnt offering was brought on the first day of the seventh month?
questions.explanation: They were to offer one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old without defect.

answers.text: Two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs
Thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen lambs
Seven bulls, seven rams and seven lambs
One young bull, one ram and seven male lambs

questions.text: Besides holding a holy convocation, what were the people told to do on the tenth day of the seventh month?
questions.explanation: On the tenth day of the seventh month they were to have a holy convocation, afflict their souls and do no kind of work.

questions.text: For how many days were they to keep a feast to Yahweh from the fifteenth day of the seventh month?
questions.explanation: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month they were to keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.

questions.text: How many young bulls were offered on the first day of that feast?
questions.explanation: On the first day they offered thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old.

questions.text: How many rams were offered on the first day of that feast?
questions.explanation: The burnt offering on that day was thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old.

questions.text: How many young bulls were offered on the second day of the feast?
questions.explanation: On the second day they offered twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old.

questions.text: How many bulls were offered on the seventh day of the feast?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day they offered seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old.

questions.text: What were they to have on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: On the eighth day they were to have a solemn assembly and do no regular work.

answers.text: A day of blowing of trumpets
A day to afflict their souls

questions.text: The offerings of the set feasts were to be brought in addition to what?
questions.explanation: These were offered in the set feasts in addition to their vows and their free will offerings.

answers.text: Their vows and their free will offerings
